content_sections.heading: BEL Apprentice Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: BEL has invited ITI candidates for apprenticeship training in various trades. The available trades include:

rows.trade: DMM, Fitter, COPA, Turner, Welder, Electrician

content_sections.heading: BEL Apprentice Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for BEL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 must fulfil the eligibility conditions mentioned in the notification. Candidates must have passed ITI. ITI candidates who passed on or after 01 January 2022 are eligible. Candidates pursuing final semester/final year ITI and awaiting results are not eligible. The maximum age limit is 21 years as on 01 September 2025. SC/ST candidates: 5 years age relaxation OBC candidates: 3 years age relaxation Candidates are advised to check whether they satisfy the prescribed age limit before applying. Use our online Age Calculator to calculate your exact age instantly. Only candidates from Southern Region states are eligible: Karnataka Kerala Tamil Nadu Andhra Pradesh Telangana

content_sections.heading: BEL Apprentice Stipend 2026
content_sections.text: Selected apprentices will receive a monthly stipend during the apprenticeship training period.

rows.trade_category: Fitter, DMM, Electrician, Turner, EP, Electronic Mechanic

content_sections.heading: BEL Apprentice Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates will be selected based on their performance in the written test.

rows.information: Centre for Learning and Development, Jalahalli, Bangalore - 560013

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for BEL Apprentice Selection
content_sections.text: Candidates must bring the following original documents for verification: SSLC / 10th Marks Card Aadhaar Card ITI Original Marks Sheet issued by NCVT/SCVT SC/ST/OBC Certificate, if applicable

content_sections.heading: BEL Apprentice Facilities 2026
content_sections.text: Subsidized canteen, transport and accommodation on chargeable basis. Free OPD medical facility at BEL hospital as per company norms. Group Personal Accident Insurance coverage of ₹5,00,000.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for BEL Apprentice Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates can apply by appearing for the BEL walk-in written test at the scheduled venue with the required original documents. Check the eligibility criteria and applicable trade. Visit the selection centre on the scheduled date. Carry original certificates and required documents. Appear for the written test.

faq.question: Q1. What is BEL Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: BEL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 is an apprenticeship training opportunity announced by Bharat Electronics Limited for ITI candidates under the Apprenticeship Act, 1961.

faq.question: Q2. What is the qualification for BEL Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed ITI in the relevant trade. ITI candidates passed on or after 01 January 2022 are eligible.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for BEL Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 21 years as on 01 September 2025. Age relaxation is available for SC/ST and OBC candidates as per notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the BEL Apprentice stipend?
faq.answer: The stipend is ₹11,040 per month for Fitter, DMM, Electrician, Turner, EP and Electronic Mechanic trades, and ₹10,040 per month for COPA/PASAA and Welder trades.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for BEL Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection will be based on performance in the written test.

faq.question: Q6. Where is the BEL Apprentice walk-in selection conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in written test will be conducted at Centre for Learning and Development, Jalahalli, Bangalore.
